task_description.overview: Remove or deconvolve the instrument response from raw seismic waveform data to obtain true ground motion (e.g., displacement).
steps: Load seismic waveform data into a Stream object (from FDSN client or local file).
Load instrument response metadata into an Inventory object (StationXML, RESP, or SEED/Dataless file).
Define a pre-filter band to stabilize deconvolution (e.g., pre_filt = [f1, f2, f3, f4]).
Call Stream.remove_response() on the waveform data with parameters: inventory, output unit, pre_filt, optional water_level, plot flag.
Verify results optionally by visualizing frequency-domain steps or time-series.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load the seismic waveform from {seismic_waveform_path} and the instrument response metadata from {inventory_path}. Apply remove_response with pre_filt={pre_filt} and water_level={water_level}, set plot=True to visulize the processing process. Save the removed response data to {removed_response_data} and the plot to {removed_response_plot}.
